question: Should ClawScan adopt the canonical autoreview inspection, model-fallback, and supported-engine contract exactly as pinned?
rationale: The implementation is exact and well validated, but it deliberately changes a security-sensitive reviewer boundary and removes existing optional engine paths; source review cannot authorize those repository-policy choices.

options.title: Adopt canonical contract
options.body: Accept the upstream trust and compatibility policy as ClawScan's review standard and merge the exact synchronized tree.

options.title: Revise upstream first
options.body: If the new boundary is unsuitable, change and validate the canonical `openclaw/agent-skills` implementation before synchronizing ClawScan again.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical contract
recommendation.body: Accept the upstream trust and compatibility policy as ClawScan's review standard and merge the exact synchronized tree.
